prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, style-transfer.
Asset: one transparent medieval fantasy dialogue portrait, tight 74×100 logical pixel grid. Substantially redraw Image 1 into a close head portrait. Image 1 alone is the identity reference. Images 2–5 are hard-edged small-grid anatomy/style references only; never copy their identities.
Identity: Goren, a strong male charcoal worker in his thirties. Preserve the tousled short dark warm-brown hair, heavy straight eyebrows, broad sturdy angular face, connected short dark-brown moustache and beard, and three-quarter orientation looking toward image left. Current character card is authoritative: lightly ash-dusted brow/hair, smoke-weathered nostril edges, unmistakably a working adult in his thirties, not a child, model, or white-haired elder. Ash reads in a few muted gray-brown shapes, not floating speckles or new wounds. Keep the charcoal-gray work shirt visible only as a narrow collar; a very small muted flax-gray linen fold may meet one edge. No apron/chest required in this crop. Expression: quietly firm and fatigued, questioning sidelong gaze; eyebrows grounded, compressed closed mouth. He is insisting on his earned wages and safe work, not the ransom protagonist. Do not dramatize him as angry, weeping, saintly, cured, or guilty. A private amulet remains outside this tight crop; do not invent magic or erase his beliefs.
Framing is crucial: LARGE FACE fills the image, compact hair mass, short neck, narrow collar only. The entire head silhouette, crown, all visible ears, and any scarf knot have genuine transparent clearance. Place all opaque content within logical x=3..70 and y=3..96; at least 3 logical pixels of transparent margin along every side. Face starts around y=17 and chin/beard ends around y=86; only 7–9 logical pixels of neck/collar. No shoulders or chest. Do not shrink the face to fit tall hair. Keep the lower collar as a narrow supporting base.
Pixel style: emulate the references' solid low-resolution hard-edged pixel clusters. Broad contiguous structural forehead, big readable nose, cheekbone, jaw and chin planes. Small dark eyes with only tiny muted tan sclera, no bright white blocks, shine or oversized eyes. Hair and beard in a few broad irregular interlocking masses, no thin strands, isolated speckles, hatching or fine texture. Aim for no more than 32 flat earthy colors. Fully transparent background with solid silhouette edges.
No gradients, blur, antialiasing, smooth painting, dithering, noisy micro-pixels, props, hands, text, badges, scenery, full body, border or watermark. One portrait only.
